subject: Logic
title: Mechanism Design
description: A fast breakdown of Mechanism Design for builders.

hook.text: Two kids fighting over cake? Let one cut, the other pick. Suddenly, both are incentivized to be fair.

buildup.text: Mechanism design is reverse game theory—designing rules so self-interested players produce good outcomes.

discovery.text: Instead of predicting behavior within a game, you design the game itself so the desired behavior is rational.

twist.text: Auctions, insurance deductibles, and tax brackets are all mechanisms designed to align incentives.

climax.text: The insight: don't fight self-interest—harness it. Make the right choice also the selfish choice.

punchline.text: Design the game so everyone wants to play fair.

quiz.question: What is mechanism design?
options: Designing rules so self-interested players produce good outcomes
